summary: Bilibili Inc. filed a Form 6-K with the SEC on July 8, 2026, attaching a monthly return submitted to the Hong Kong Stock Exchange regarding movements in its authorized and issued share capital for June 2026. The filing shows an increase in issued Class Z ordinary shares by 1,714,162 shares, from 337,091,593 to 338,805,755, with no changes to authorized share capital or treasury shares. This is a routine regulatory compliance filing, not a special situation. It reports no deal terms, board recommendations, or strategic actions.
